name: Calling The Bad Good
overview: Scripture sternly warns against the dangerous practice of calling evil good and good evil, highlighting it as an abomination to the LORD. Proverbs and Isaiah emphasize that justifying the wicked or declaring them righteous brings divine condemnation and societal curse. This deceit not only misleads the righteous and strengthens the wicked in their ways, as Ezekiel reveals, but also grieves God, who is wearied by those who claim that evil is pleasing to Him, as Malachi declares. Furthermore, Matthew teaches that an evil perspective corrupts the whole person, filling them with profound darkness.
